diagnosis: Account uses Legacy Auth, so the standard token reset flow applies. No escalation needed per policy.
reply: Hello, since your account is on Legacy Auth, you can reset your API token by opening the Security tab and choosing "Reset token." Note that the previous API token will remain valid for 24 hours after the reset, so plan your integration cutover within that window. If you later migrate to Unified Auth, account-wide tokens are replaced with scoped keys. Please let us know if you have any other questions!
